vectors.name: hello-minimal
vectors.note: Hello with every field at its default; the regen marker: set APPRICOT_REGEN_VECTORS=1 to rewrite this file from the generators

vectors.name: hello-resume
vectors.note: Hello with codecs [QOI, RAW] and a resume_serial, exercising packed repeated and optional fields

vectors.name: hello-reply
vectors.note: HelloReply with resume fields set; max_frame_credits is MAX_FRAME_CREDITS

vectors.name: bye-peer-closed
vectors.note: Bye with the zero enum value, which proto3 omits from the wire

vectors.name: bye-limit-violation
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_LIMIT_VIOLATION (0x101): a non-zero enum value in the oneof

vectors.name: server-error
vectors.note: ServerError code 4 (decode failure) with untrusted display text

vectors.name: surface-new-toplevel
vectors.note: A plain toplevel at 1x scale with title and app id

vectors.name: surface-new-greek-title
vectors.note: SurfaceNew whose title is Greek: UTF-8 multibyte text in a string field

vectors.name: surface-new-popup
vectors.note: A popup with parent, positioner (anchor, gravity) and negative offset coordinates as zigzag sint32

vectors.name: surface-gone
vectors.note: SurfaceGone with reason GONE_SESSION_END

vectors.name: surface-metadata
vectors.note: SurfaceMetadata changing title and scale, leaving app id absent

vectors.name: focus-ask
vectors.note: The app asking the host for focus

vectors.name: resize-ask
vectors.note: The app asking to resize itself to 800x600

vectors.name: configure
vectors.note: The host proposing 800x600 under serial 7

vectors.name: configure-ack
vectors.note: The app applying serial 7 at a size of its own

vectors.name: frame-two-tiles
vectors.note: A full redraw of two 2x2 RAW tiles (16 bytes each) at sequence 1

vectors.name: frame-raw-1x1
vectors.note: A delta frame of one 1x1 RAW tile (codec 1, 4 bytes B,G,R,unused)

vectors.name: frame-ack
vectors.note: The client acking sequence 1 as drawn

vectors.name: cursor-image
vectors.note: A 2x2 ARGB cursor, hotspot (1,0), 16 premultiplied bytes

vectors.name: cursor-gone
vectors.note: The empty CursorGone message

vectors.name: pointer-move
vectors.note: A move to (100, -5); the negative y is a zigzag sint32

vectors.name: pointer-button
vectors.note: Left button (X button 1) pressed

vectors.name: pointer-axis
vectors.note: Two discrete wheel steps up (steps_y negative is up), none sideways

vectors.name: key-press
vectors.note: 'a' down with shift (modifier 1)

vectors.name: key-altgr-greek
vectors.note: Greek alpha (keysym 0x03b1) through AltGr (modifier bit 32)

vectors.name: focus-notify
vectors.note: The host moving focus to surface 3

vectors.name: blur-release
vectors.note: The empty BlurRelease message

vectors.name: clipboard-set
vectors.note: Paste text from the host to the app

vectors.name: clipboard-ask
vectors.note: The empty ClipboardAsk message

vectors.name: close-request
vectors.note: The host user closing surface 1's chrome

vectors.name: hello-at-every-cap
vectors.note: Hello with client_name, stream_token and codecs each exactly at its cap

vectors.name: hello-version-1-resume-zero
vectors.note: Hello asking for version 1, which a v0 server refuses with BYE_PROTOCOL_VERSION but the codec carries; resume_serial present at 0, an optional field at its default

vectors.name: hello-reply-at-every-cap
vectors.note: HelloReply resumed, version 1, session_id and codecs at their caps, and both optional fields present at 0

vectors.name: bye-protocol-version
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_PROTOCOL_VERSION (0x100)

vectors.name: bye-auth-failed
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_AUTH_FAILED (0x102) and no text

vectors.name: bye-protocol-violation-text-at-cap
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_PROTOCOL_VIOLATION (0x103) and a Greek text of exactly MAX_BYE_TEXT_BYTES

vectors.name: bye-session-gone
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_SESSION_GONE (0x104)

vectors.name: bye-server-shutdown
vectors.note: Bye with reason BYE_SERVER_SHUTDOWN (0x105)

vectors.name: server-error-at-cap
vectors.note: ServerError code 5 (internal error) with a Greek text of exactly MAX_ERROR_TEXT_BYTES

vectors.name: surface-new-at-every-cap
vectors.note: SurfaceNew at the width, height, title and app id caps (the title in two-byte Greek), the largest id, parent_id present at 0, scale 2x

vectors.name: surface-new-popup-top-bottom
vectors.note: A popup anchored at ANCHOR_TOP (1) with gravity ANCHOR_BOTTOM (2)

vectors.name: surface-new-popup-left-right
vectors.note: A popup anchored at ANCHOR_LEFT (3) with gravity ANCHOR_RIGHT (4)

vectors.name: surface-new-popup-corners-extremes
vectors.note: A popup anchored at ANCHOR_TOP_LEFT (5) with gravity ANCHOR_BOTTOM_RIGHT (8), its offset at the sint32 extremes: five-byte zigzag varints

vectors.name: surface-new-popup-center-at-cap
vectors.note: A popup at ANCHOR_CENTER (0) with gravity ANCHOR_CENTER, both omitted as proto3 defaults, no anchor_rect, and the largest size

vectors.name: surface-gone-app-closed
vectors.note: SurfaceGone with reason GONE_APP_CLOSED (0), omitted as the proto3 default

vectors.name: surface-gone-parent-gone
vectors.note: SurfaceGone with reason GONE_PARENT_GONE (1)

vectors.name: surface-metadata-app-id-at-cap
vectors.note: SurfaceMetadata with title present but empty, an optional string at its default, and app_id at MAX_APP_ID_BYTES

vectors.name: resize-ask-at-cap
vectors.note: ResizeAsk for the largest surface

vectors.name: configure-at-cap
vectors.note: Configure with the largest serial and the largest surface

vectors.name: configure-ack-serial-zero
vectors.note: ConfigureAck with serial 0, omitted as the proto3 default: the server's ack of a size change the host did not configure

vectors.name: frame-tiles-at-cap
vectors.note: A frame of MAX_TILES_PER_FRAME 1x1 RAW tiles

vectors.name: frame-qoi-2x2
vectors.note: One 2x2 tile in codec 2 (QOI): a three-channel stream built from the spec

vectors.name: frame-tile-at-every-cap
vectors.note: One RAW tile at the tile width, height and byte caps: 256x256, 262144 bytes

vectors.name: cursor-image-at-cap
vectors.note: A 128x128 cursor, hotspot at its far corner: 65536 bytes, MAX_CURSOR_BYTES

vectors.name: pointer-move-extremes
vectors.note: A move to the sint32 extremes: five-byte zigzag varints

vectors.name: pointer-axis-at-cap
vectors.note: MAX_POINTER_AXIS_STEPS steps right (steps_x 64) and up (steps_y -64)

vectors.name: key-code-at-cap
vectors.note: A key release whose code is 16 bytes, MAX_KEY_CODE_BYTES, with the X11 Unicode keysym for Greek alpha (0x010003b1)

vectors.name: clipboard-set-at-cap
vectors.note: ClipboardSet text of exactly MAX_CLIPBOARD_BYTES, in two-byte Greek

lenient.name: hello-unknown-varint-field
lenient.note: hello-resume with an unknown field 9 (a varint) at its end: skipped

lenient.name: surface-new-unknown-string-field

lenient.name: surface-new-popup-nested-unknown-fields

lenient.name: hello-codecs-unpacked

lenient.name: hello-codecs-split-packed
lenient.note: Hello whose codecs [QOI, RAW] come as two packed runs, counted together

lenient.name: focus-notify-non-minimal-varint
lenient.note: FocusNotify whose surface_id 3 is a two-byte varint (83 00)

lenient.name: frame-ack-explicit-default
lenient.note: FrameAck that writes surface_id 0 out, which proto3 omits

lenient.name: pointer-button-pressed-as-two
lenient.note: PointerButton whose bool pressed is the varint 2: any non-zero is true

lenient.name: clipboard-ask-unknown-field

lenient.name: key-unknown-fixed64-field
lenient.note: key-press with an unknown field 5 (a fixed64) before its known fields
